key_insight: ProIQA evaluates math item quality by modeling the full problem-solving process, not just the problem stem, to assess knowledge, difficulty, and competencies more finely.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable, process-aware quality control layer for AIG pipelines in intelligent education systems, improving how generated math items are screened before deployment.
method: Constructs structured reasoning trees from raw solutions using LLMs.
Encodes the tree topology and procedural semantics with a GNN.
Fuses stem semantics with solving-process representations in a dual-view "Stem + Solving" model.
evidence_signal: The authors report extensive experiments on K12 mathematical datasets, showing the framework captures process-oriented features for fine-grained assessment.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate reasoning-tree construction from solutions, so noisy LLM-generated process structures could affect assessment reliability.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
